title: 封裝供電完整性設計
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入封裝 PDN 的 IR drop、Ldi/dt、反共振及量測；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine package pdn ir drop, ldi/dt, antiresonance and metrology. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。目標阻抗是設計工具，不代表每個頻率都可用同一標量完整描述多埠供電網路；要匹配負載頻譜及量測參考面。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Target impedance is a design tool, not a complete scalar description of every multiport PDN frequency; match load spectra and reference planes.

stages.title: 負載與電壓預算
stages.description: 本階段處理負載與電壓預算：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address loads and voltage budget through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 分配電壓容差
steps.titleEn: Allocate voltage tolerance
steps.objective: 建立「分配電壓容差」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：DC 壓降、動態下陷和漣波共用有限容差，需避免重複計算。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for allocate voltage tolerance: DC drop, dynamic droop and ripple share finite tolerance.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。把電壓預算分成獨立欄位。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Split the voltage budget into separate terms. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：把電壓預算分成獨立欄位。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Split the voltage budget into separate terms. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：DC 壓降合格就保證所有瞬態合格。本步先檢查「分配電壓容差」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到DC 壓降、動態下陷和漣波共用有限容差，需避免重複計算。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Passing DC drop guarantees all transients. First check whether evidence for allocate voltage tolerance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: DC drop, dynamic droop and ripple share finite tolerance.
steps.check: 交付「分配電壓容差」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for allocate voltage tolerance, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「封裝供電完整性設計」的「分配電壓容差」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「熱島救援：模組交付前夜」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Allocate voltage tolerance” in “Package power-integrity design”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Thermal Island: Before Module Delivery” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.check: 交付「分配電壓容差」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。

steps.title: 設定目標阻抗
steps.titleEn: Set impedance target
steps.objective: 建立「設定目標阻抗」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：ΔV/ΔI 是初始頻域目標，必須指定對應擾動範圍。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for set impedance target: ΔV/ΔI is an initial frequency target with a defined disturbance range.
steps.instruction:
先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。驗算 3 mΩ 例並列頻帶。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。

假設允許動態壓降 30 mV、負載變化 10 A，初步 Ztarget=3 mΩ；若 DC 路徑 R=2 mΩ、電流 20 A，另有 40 mV DC 壓降，不能從同一預算重複支出。
steps.instructionEn:
Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Check the 3 mΩ example and define the band. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.

For 30 mV dynamic droop and 10 A load change, initial Ztarget=3 mΩ. A 2 mΩ DC path at 20 A adds 40 mV DC drop and cannot reuse the same budget.

steps.instructionEn:
Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. Check the 3 mΩ example and define the band. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.

For 30 mV dynamic droop and 10 A load change, initial Ztarget=3 mΩ. A 2 mΩ DC path at 20 A adds 40 mV DC drop and cannot reuse the same budget.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：驗算 3 mΩ 例並列頻帶。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Check the 3 mΩ example and define the band. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：只量電源端就能代表每個晶粒焊墊。本步先檢查「設定目標阻抗」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到ΔV/ΔI 是初始頻域目標，必須指定對應擾動範圍。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Supply-terminal measurement represents every die pad. First check whether evidence for set impedance target actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: ΔV/ΔI is an initial frequency target with a defined disturbance range.
steps.check: 交付「設定目標阻抗」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for set impedance target: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.

knowledge.text: 假設允許動態壓降 30 mV、負載變化 10 A，初步 Ztarget=3 mΩ；若 DC 路徑 R=2 mΩ、電流 20 A，另有 40 mV DC 壓降，不能從同一預算重複支出。 目標阻抗是設計工具，不代表每個頻率都可用同一標量完整描述多埠供電網路；要匹配負載頻譜及量測參考面。
knowledge.textEn: For 30 mV dynamic droop and 10 A load change, initial Ztarget=3 mΩ. A 2 mΩ DC path at 20 A adds 40 mV DC drop and cannot reuse the same budget. Target impedance is a design tool, not a complete scalar description of every multiport PDN frequency; match load spectra and reference planes.
